confidence_notes: The site was identified as a classic ASP.NET/WebForms page with no observed API, so the script uses Playwright rather than requests for search, postback, pagination, and detail rendering.
The inspection verified the search input, submit control, listing table, detail-link pattern, and next-page selector, but pagination beyond the first page was not tested live.

The input inspection explicitly says there is no header row; the script treats the first column as keyword data and also supports an optional first-row header containing keyword, listing_url, and detail_url.
Listing column positions are assumed to follow the observed order: Nº, Data, Nome, Tipologia, Capacidade, Localização, Certificações.
Detail fields are extracted from label/value table rows and conservative text fallbacks because exact detail-page field-row selectors were not fully provided.
Capacity and explorer sections were observed but their exact field markup was not specified; extraction may therefore be lower confidence for those fields.
No review accordions were observed. The --mask-reviews option and masking helper are included, but this target's requested fields do not intentionally collect review text.
Dates are preserved exactly as rendered, including the future-dated sample values noted in the inspection.
The mandatory price rules are not applicable because this accommodation registry does not expose a product price field in the inspected requirements.
